notes.content:
Gameplay

 Movement rework: Better air control, more weight in the air, coyote time.
 Added melee damage from the velocity when hitting a target.
 Arena Gamemode ! (In testing, if it's fun we'll develop it, otherwise trash!)
 Team system update: colored nicknames and player outlines, score persistance, and defined team spawn points.
 Player spawns now check if there is a player close to is to avoid spawning on other players.
 Added fastFallRatio (the longer you fall the faster).
 New JMP maps (jmp-surf and jmp-bhop).


Graphic

 First person UI rework. (Chat, stats, annonces, etc).
 Weapons VFX rework.
 Added an explosion decal.
 "Dither" graphic option (enabled by default).


Audio

 Added weapon switch SFX.
 Shorten the hitmarker SFX to be spamable.


Other

 Workshop ! Consult the guides (from BulletSpeed not the Playtest).
 Leaderboard on JMP and ARN maps.
 Added console commands for movement config.
 Trenchbroom config update (spotlight, textures, etc).



Fixs

 No more grey screen of death !
 Object spawner now sync properly between server and clients (less bandwith usage too).
 Fixed russian localization.
 Fixed shotgun ammo consuption.
 Other little fixs.

notes.title: 0.10 + Playtest
notes.content:
Switch from Demo to Playtest
After seeing what the other indie FPS developers were doing I decided to switch the marketing model of BulletSpeed.
I will switch to a basic version model of the free game, and the solo content will be sold as DLC.
This will allow the free and paid version to play together on the same servers.
The price of DLC is not yet estimated and will be estimated at the height of the game time that can offer the single player content.
Until the multiplayer content is looped the game will probably remain in playtest open. 


GAMEPLAY
Weapon System Rework
Ammo

 Ammunition is now grouped by category and not by weapon.
 Ammo packs reload at 30% of maximum capacity.
 Weapons drop take 15% of the corresponding ammo from the player who drops it.
 Weapons created by the map have 50% of maximum ammunition.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921620/3e945716a8454a959538c732bbabf9a628d29740.png
Melee

 Left Click (default) puts a cost to 75 damage and causes recoil to the player touch.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921620/6ee5be9bc0ec64786e54157183b985ac04332e15.gif{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921620/e888ae03a47ee8069a11982e30282de7ac581174.gif
 Right click press (default) will charge a powerful hit that will send once the key release and cause a more powerful recoil to the player touch.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921620/bc4fcbf2aa158896d90f890a0438f04d3a72c7bb.gif{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921620/3941ad8de662b84ea162a01d9a9c39634e1e8883.gif

New pickable !
Scaped Metals
Upon their death, players drop "scrapped metals" to their death allowing to heal themselves in life/armor up to +50.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921620/91b9bc02a1bfdb102be14ea551b9231e6b9a1f90.png
Better hit !
Hitbox
Creation of hitbox linked to the body parts.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921620/941413a840c4b0d0c487d34a0b6e3b4bc9fa9af4.png


VISUALS
Model Rework
Animations
Complete redesign of third-person animations.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921620/7df90b10e4271277aeef6f2b85433d4beb7fae1e.gif
VFX

 New trails more optimized for bullets.
 Trail behind the player when they dash or wall-jump.
 New effects for Deathzone, MapLimit and all triggers.

Models
New model for ammunition boxes.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921620/ab998d418df195069380a9a13e675aefc174d655.png


CUSTOM CONTENT
Map creation
You can now create maps with the guide available here: 
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3358286673&preview=true
Workshop will come later for now you can use the discussions to share maps.


FIXS

 Fixed player spawn.
 Fixed weapon start.
 Many other little fixs.

notes.title: Multiplayer / Visual
notes.content:
Steam P2P

Steam P2P is on Bullet Speed !

In other words, it is now much easier to play multiplayer thanks to the Steam lobby system which now replaces the old system.
It is still possible to play with UPNP to open ports but the servers will not appear in the server list and will have to be connected to via IP.



VFX

Rework and addition of visual effects !
I'll let you discover in game :)


Note: Work on single player content is still in progress, the first thing available will probably be an arena mode with infinite wave of enemies and a leaderboard.
JMP leaderboards will be available with the next JMP maps.

Graphics:

 Map limit is now visible when close.



Network:

 Simplified UPNP Setup.



Other:

 New binds: Inspect weapon, Escape/Tab menus, Fixed binds for weapons.
 New options: Stay on scope, Auto pickup weapon on the ground, Auto sort picked up weapons.



Fix:

 Fixed shooting animation cancel glitch.
 Fixed three-way map limit geometry.
 Fixed spacebar bind bug.



Note by Lambda:
Thank you for keeping up with the game ! Two friends joined me on this project.
Since none of us had worked on a game team project we had to adapt. That's why the game had no update in two months.
But now we are working on content related things so the next updates will be parsed and with little additions until 0.10. 
So please be patient we are cooking !

0.9.1

Gameplay:


 Disable weapon drop and map reset when chat is on focus.
 Dash modification:
 Increased the dash power if player speed is less than 100u/s.
 Increased the dash power if player is on the ground.
 New tutorial map "tutorial". 



Graphics:


 HUD element visibility oiptions.



Audio:


 Raised all volumes to +5db.
 Default volumes are now 50% SFX and 40% MUSIC.
 Three-way music is now looping.



Other:


 Cached some gameplay entities for faster loading in game.
 Spray and crosshair selection are now saved.
 Optimized 3d trails.



Fix:


 Discord rich presence not refreshing after joining another game.
 Fixed a minor bug where chat fade out at the wrong time.
 Fixed a major bug when player could play with their hitbox disabled.
 Fixed a major bug that could kill player instantly after respawning.

notes.title: 0.9.0 IS OUT !
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921620/e5a2870a43d4ed8dda0e31d588636aef4e4cdc0d.png

Gameplay:

 	New maps: Temple (DM 2-4 players).
 	Weapon knockback property: Push the player in the opposite direction he shot.
 		Electrifier: 0 -> 0.3
 	Weapon damage:
 		Headshot: 2x  -> 2.5x
 		Revolver: 100 -> 80
 	Weapon make decal property.
 	Bullets ignore collision against objects (Pickables).
 	If you had a starter weapon in hand when you were killed, you drop ammo instead of the weapon.	
 	Disabled move when the menu is open.
 	Open the menu if the game is not focused while in game.


Graphics:

 	Scaled down the floor texture on all maps.
 	Slight fog on JMP maps.
 	Hitmarker animation.
 	New HUD elements: Altimeter, Distance measurement, Info box
 	Glitch effect on hurt and death.
 	New graphics options: SDFGI, SSIL, Vsync, Weapon FOV


Audio:

 	Hurt sound is more "machine like".
 	Change all music format to OGG so it loops correctly now.


Network:

 	Big network optimization.
 		Less bandwith usage.
 		More reliable data sending and receiving.
 		Better spray compression.
 		Refactored the way physic bullets worked.
 	Display the server IP in the netinfo box (bottom right in game), enabled by default (setting is in option/game).
 	ONLINE setting for the server creation is enabled by default. 


Other:

 	Loading screen that compile shader and preload objects.
 	Game build size optimization (From 841Mo to 337Mo).
 	Game localization: English, French, Russian (more comming soon)


Fix:

 	Fixed a bug where some clients couldn't zoom with the sniper.
 	Fixed a self shooting issue with collisions.
 	Fixed other minor bugs.

Gameplay:

 	Added DM-Temple (wip)


Graphics:

 	New menu !
 	Model geometry fixed
